G'oya

Guruhlashdan oldin har bir nomni bitta shaklga keltiramiz: TRIM chetidagi probellarni oladi, LOWER harflarni kichik qiladi. Shundan keyin toshkent , TOSHKENT va Toshkent bir xil toshkent bo'ladi va bitta guruhga tushadi.

Yechim

SELECT LOWER(TRIM(city)) AS city, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE TRIM(city) <> ''
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(city))

WHERE TRIM(city) <> '' bir yo'la ikki narsani chiqarib tashlaydi: bo'sh va probelli shaharni (shart yolg'on) hamda NULL ni (shart NULL).

Tuzoqlar

GROUP BY da ifoda o'rniga city yozish xavfli. Natija ustuni ham city deb nomlangan bo'lsa ham, ikkala dialekt GROUP BY city ni jadvaldagi asl ustun deb tushunadi va guruhlar yana uchga bo'linadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT LOWER(TRIM(city)) AS city, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE TRIM(city) <> ''
GROUP BY city

Faqat LOWER yoki faqat TRIM ham yetmaydi: biri harflarni, ikkinchisi probellarni bir xil qiladi, bizga ikkalasi kerak.
